regions.full_page: God bless you Miss Alice O'Brien -- you and yours. Many thanks too for your kind favor of Oct. 6th -- duely received and noted. Yes I quited enjoyed the short visit with the five guests over night, etc. ... Indeed I did know your Mother Anna -- almost like a sister. I stopped several weeks while learning to run the trolly cars in 1887 with our Aunt Mary and Uncle Pat and of course. She was (I think) a few years older than I but we were quite friends: -- also when I started working in the State's Prison- - Uncle Pat one of the guards. ... When you write to Joe, tell him. Best Regards and God's blessing from Fr. Sol. I think I owe him a letter or two: but my big problem is my correspondence. So please pray that be able to speed up. --- Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap.
